Payout of 17 July is short ₹658.00.
The bank credited ₹2,13,019.77 against an expected ₹2,13,677.77. 14 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
